verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the Orchard Road area, Singapore's shopping and entertainment district.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the Orchard Road area, Singapore’s iconic shopping and entertainment district

verified_facts.text: The hotel has two wings: the Grand Wing, a Grand Living Room where guests convene and celebrate, and the Terrace Wing, an urban oasis and wellness haven with lush landscaping and a cascading waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: both Grand Wing—a Grand Living Room where guests convene and celebrate—and Terrace Wing, an urban oasis and wellness haven steps from the bustling streets with lush landscaping and a cascading waterfall

verified_facts.text: Grand Wing rooms have contemporary interiors with accents that pay homage to Singapore's heritage, while Terrace Wing rooms are nature-inspired with wooden furnishings and marble-green tones.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the Grand Wing, contemporary interiors are enriched with accents that pay homage to Singapore’s heritage, while the Terrace Wing offers a nature‑inspired stay with wooden furnishings and marble‑green tones

verified_facts.text: The Garden Studio is a studio-styled room with a high ceiling and direct access to the Terrace Wing gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: studio-styled guestroom with high ceiling and direct access to the tranquil Terrace Wing gardens

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a full kitchen with a separate butler entrance, a dining area, a powder room, an office and a private bedroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: complete with a full kitchen with separate butler entrance, dining area, powder room, office, and private bedroom

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pools include a semi-Olympic-sized pool for laps and a hydro-massage saltwater pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: swimming laps in the semi-Olympic-sized pool or unwind with a massage in the hydro-massage saltwater pool

verified_facts.text: Damai, meaning peace in Malay, is the hotel's wellness haven and spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Damai, meaning "peace" in Malay, is a reimagined wellness haven in Grand Hyatt Singapore

verified_facts.text: Damai Spa's signature Recovery treatment, developed in-house, combines heat therapy, light therapy and acupressure massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: the signature, science-backed Recovery treatment, developed in-house, that combines advanced heat therapy, light therapy, and acupressure massages

verified_facts.text: Damai House has a mind-body-therapy wall and hosts functional movement classes, free for guests, from vertical yoga to tai chi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Damai House, with its mind-body-therapy wall, is a space for functional movement classes—that are free for guests—from vertical yoga to tai chi.

verified_facts.text: The Garden Oasis on the fifth floor has winding paths, banyan trees and butterflies.
verified_facts.excerpt: the lush Garden Oasis on the fifth floor, with its winding paths, banyan trees, and butterflies

verified_facts.text: The Garden Oasis is part of the Orchard Road Butterfly Trail, a green-corridor initiative developed with the national parks board and the Nature Society Singapore.
verified_facts.excerpt: part of the Orchard Road Butterfly Trail, a green-corridor initiative developed in partnership with the national parks board and the Nature Society Singapore

verified_facts.text: The interiors were redesigned under design director Yohei Akao of Strickland, with landscape architects Grant Associates.
verified_facts.excerpt: resurrected under the care of design director Yohei Akao of the award-winning design firm Strickland, and renowned landscape architects Grant Associates

verified_facts.text: The lobby is marbled, with wooden columns and a spiral staircase.
verified_facts.excerpt: cavernous marbled lobby, with its wooden columns and iconic spiral staircase

verified_facts.text: Room mirrors and ceilings are accented with woven rattan, and soft furnishings are in tones of spring green.
verified_facts.excerpt: The soft furnishings are dressed in elegant tones of spring green; the mirrors and ceilings accented with intricately woven rattan

verified_facts.text: StraitsKitchen is a halal-certified buffet of Singaporean dishes in a marketplace setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Uniquely Singaporean, savour authentic and refined local dishes in a vibrant marketplace setting. Celebrating Singapore’s diverse food culture, the halal-certified buffet is Muslim-friendly

verified_facts.text: Le Pristine Singapore serves Modern European sharing cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu brings Modern European sharing cuisine through tradition and innovation

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club on Level 1M offers breakfast options, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: the new Grand Club on Level 1M in an intimate atmosphere, including breakfast options, all-day refreshments, and an evening cocktail experience

verified_facts.text: The club lounge has play areas for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sprawling new club lounge has play areas for children.

verified_facts.text: Room daybeds can be converted to beds that sleep two children under 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: The daybeds in the rooms can be converted to beds that sleep two kids below the age of 12.

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms join a king room and a twin room by an internal door and are designed with families and groups in mind.
verified_facts.excerpt: A combination of one king bed room and one twin bed room, connected by an internal door and designed with families and groups in mind

verified_facts.text: The hotel has its own bespoke water bottling plant.

verified_facts.text: Tangs department store is next door, and Far East Plaza is a couple of doors down.
verified_facts.excerpt: Next door, to your left, is Singapore’s oldest department store, Tangs, one of the best places to pick up local souvenirs. On your right, a couple of doors down, you’ll find Far East Plaza

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a popular spot for office and family gatherings and wedding celebrations.

verified_facts.text: The spa and fitness center are open to non-guests.
